newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's BR cuts profit forecast -- report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's BR cuts profit forecast -- report.

text.p: Fuel distributor Petrobras Distribuidora (BR) has lowered its profit forecast for 1996 to 140 million reais ($140 million) from 150 million ($150 million), a news agency said.

Invest News quoted BR Director Antonio Rubens Silva as saying that in the last two years 45 new fuel distributors have entered the Brazilian market, and as a result BR's market share has fallen from 36 percent to 35 percent.
BR's turnover for 1996 is expected to be around 7.4 billion reais ($7.4 billion), according to Invest News.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom 5521 507 4151
